groups.name: File focus derivation from approval history
groups.rationale: Adds the core logic to compute how much attention each file needs by examining its approval history across rounds.
groups.watch: fileFocus returns 'new' for files with one or fewer appearances, and only returns 'approved' when a blob sha proves the file was approved and has not changed since, which excludes binary files and first appearances.

groups.name: SessionRecord rounds field made mandatory
groups.rationale: Rounds field becomes required rather than optional, enforcing that all sessions track their history and rejecting corrupted old sessions at parse time.
groups.watch: The field changes from optional to required; sessions without rounds are now rejected with a clear error message rather than silently treated as historyless, and the rejection happens in parseSession before the record is used.

groups.name: Focus data sent to browser on session read
groups.rationale: The /api/session/:key/data endpoint derives and includes file focus in its response, computed fresh from rounds on every read so it never becomes stale.
groups.watch: Focus is derived at read time and not stored, so it reflects the current truth from rounds; the comment explains that a stored copy could disagree after `end` or a re-group.

groups.name: Round and session initialization cleanups
groups.rationale: Removes unnecessary null-coalescing from code that now guarantees rounds exist, and updates comments to reflect that rounds are always present.
groups.watch: Changes from `rounds ?? []` to `rounds` assume rounds is never undefined; this is safe only because the SessionRecord type now requires it and parseSession rejects sessions without it.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
